The tape

newest first

Welcome to Rap Dream

The goal: 1,000,000 fans + $1,000,000 cash. Own the facility, a full 3-artist roster, and every market asset. Clear any advance. Win checks on sleep. Below −$250, the run ends.

The basic loop

Moves cost energy. Gear, deals, and assets cost cash. Work → cypher → record → release. Releases build fans, hype, and nightly catalog pay. Sleep resets energy, settles the night, and pays rent. Rent +$15 every 7 days: outgrow it.

What each move does

1 · workReliable cash. Degrees and network raise the pay.
2 · cypherPunch picker: read the setup and choose the bar that hits hardest.
3 · recordOne punch. Catch the pocket or the take can be trash.
4 · releaseOne vertical drop. Where you land on the band sets release quality from 1–5.
5 · promoMeme cannon: space three posts so fatigue does not kill reach.
6 · showOne gig, one crowd telegraph, one decision. Read it correctly and the show pays stronger.
M · merchTwo design rounds per drop. Bigger career, bigger drops.
7 · gearSix setups. Better gear, better takes and splits.
8 · sign artistNegotiate the split. Push too hard, they walk.
R · real estateYour read sets the return. Higher tier, harder read.
C · the market30 assets. 3 options a day: buy or sell. Network calls tomorrow's move for 1%.
archetypePicked when your run starts, beside your class. Story only, never stats: the world holds you to it.
A · label advance1 release + 25 rep. Big check now; label keeps catalog pay till 150% recoups.
E · schoolDefend the thesis. Degrees raise work pay.
0 · sleepUnder 50 energy only. Settle up, restore, pay bills.
K · partyRead the room. Richer you are, pricier the flex.
B · beef ladderTap a name to diss. Every diss counts as a release. Ignoring beef always works too.
tournamentBracket by the radar. Wins stack into championships and purses.
consultA money read: runway, income, debt, next move.

Read the business

  1. Rep opens doors: better odds, takes, shows, deals, splits.
  2. School + network raise pay: each degree pays more; network sharpens market calls.
  3. Beef is optional: ignoring every rival never blocks anything.
  4. Hype fades: releases build it, shows spend it, quiet nights cool it.
  5. Fans are leverage: stronger releases, cheaper business.
  6. Catalog is the engine: unreleased demos earn nothing.
  7. Growth bills you: bigger empire, bigger upkeep.
  8. Balance hype and rep: split them too far and reach drags.
  9. Rest days pay: no grind moves, the night still pays a dividend.
  10. Passive pay is uncapped: when the board outearns the grind, you are free.
  11. Advances scale: the check grows with the career. Still locks catalog pay till 150%.
  12. Mind the overhead: scale only when the catalog carries the bill.
